parameters.content:
## 1. Extract
Daily schedule or manual button. Content type rotates by weekday (articles, packages, Q&A, news). Reads PlacidWay's public **sitemap** (RSS is blocked), skips URLs already in the log, picks the newest. Fetches that one page (2 s gap, so under 1 request/second) and reads title, summary, image (Open Graph tags) and body text (`<main>`).

## 2. Generate + guardrails
Claude writes structured JSON (hook, 2-4 lines, CTA, hashtags). A second Claude pass checks it against the source page and removes anything unsupported. Then fixed **rules** have the final say: length, banned claim words, no prices, every number must be in the source. A failure sends Claude the exact reasons to **rewrite** (up to 3 tries), then blocks.

## 3. Publish
`PUBLISH_MODE` in **Config**: `approval` emails the reviewer Approve/Reject buttons, `auto` posts. Photo post when there is an image, link post when not. Every run is a row in the **pw_post_log** data table.

## Errors
External calls retry 3 times, 5 s apart. If they still fail: log the run as failed, email a plain-English alert, mark the execution failed. **On workflow error** catches anything else on scheduled runs.
